name: Veldtmark AirMesh UV Field Shirt
description: Loose-cut shirt in UPF-60 open-weave synth-linen, pale bone with faded indigo sleeve panels. Moisture-wicking inner layer pulls sweat away from chrome ports, with reinforced shoulder channels for spinal rig clearance. Vented back yoke lets lake wind through without flapping.
functionality: UPF-60 sun protection, chrome-port venting channels, moisture-wicking inner layer, aug-compatible shoulder seams.
what_it_says: You dress practically and know what a Great Lakes summer actually does to a body.
story_hooks: The shirt's port channel is slightly too wide — custom-cut for someone else's spinal rig model.
Someone stenciled a union glyph inside the collar, hidden unless you look.
